stops.name: Nebrodi
stops.detail: The Nebrodi, along with the Madonie to the west and the Peloritani to the east, constitute the Apennine siculo. They are facing the north directly on the Tyrrhenian Sea, while their southern limit is marked by Etna, in particular by the Alcantara River and the high Simeto River.
